periods.name: 远山金次
periods.status: alive; leader of the Wonder Noggin retrieval team during the India operation

aria.status: confirms they remain partners despite faction split; exchanges room key and reports results

sherlock-holmes.status: appointed by Sherlock to lead the retrieval team; later learns Sherlock deceived him about WATSON

carbuncle.status: defeats and charms Carbuncle, then protects her from security forces

lucifelia-moriarty-iv.status: works closely with her knowledge of Carbuncle; repeatedly fends off her advances

monkey.status: relies on her as vanguard, laser user, translator and teleport support

meluette.status: tries to rescue her after Carbuncle abducts her

hilda.status: coordinates with her to close the magic circle after the missile deflection

john-watson-i.status: discovers that Titaro-Dado is John H. Watson I and the true WATSON

key_events.role: named Reunion and accepted retrieval-team command
destroyed the Nine-Jeweled Vajra and subdued Carbuncle
redirected a Refleks missile into the half-circle magic array

periods.notes: In this volume Kinji moves from comic observer of India to operational commander. He confirms a strategic split with Aria: she remains Fort faction while he prepares ties with Gate faction for the post-Third Encounter world.
